name: Kaska Ashmane
equipment: Cinderweave Cloak (resistance to fire damage — redundant with innate resistance, worn for the party's uniform)
A trophy necklace of cooled-lava beads
A tattered hunting map of the ash wastes
A skin of ever-warm spiced wine
features: Rage (4 uses per long rest, +2 rage damage, advantage on Str checks/saves)
Unarmored Defense (AC = 10 + Dex mod + Con mod)
Reckless Attack (advantage on Str melee attacks, attacks against you gain advantage)
Danger Sense (advantage on Dex saves vs. effects you can see)
Extra Attack (two attacks per Attack action)
Fast Movement (+10 ft speed while unarmored)
Feral Instinct (advantage on initiative, can act while surprised if you rage)
Primal Path: Path of the Totem Warrior (Bear)
Spirit Seeker (cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals)
Totem Spirit — Bear (while raging, resistance to ALL damage except psychic — includes fire)
Aspect of the Beast — Bear (doubled carrying capacity, advantage on Strength checks to push/pull/lift)
Brutal Critical (one extra weapon damage die on a critical hit)
traits: Fire Resistance (innate — resistance to fire damage)
Reach to the Blaze (knows the Produce Flame cantrip; can cast Burning Hands once per long rest at 1st level)
While raging as a Bear totem, resists nearly everything the fire plane can throw at her

personality.traits: The fire in my blood answers the fire in the sky, and neither of us knows how to back down. I laugh loudest when things catch flame.
personality.ideals: Might. On a plane that burns everything, the one who cannot be burned decides how the day goes.
personality.bonds: I don't fully know where my fire came from — and the answer, my kin say, waits in the City of Brass.
personality.flaws: I run toward the biggest fire in the room, tactics be damned.

appearance: A towering fire genasi with coal-dark skin veined in dull orange that brightens to molten cracks when her temper rises. Her hair is a fixed corona of dark red flame, and her eyes glow like banked embers. She wears no armor over her ash-smudged hide vest, trusting speed, fury, and a body that simply does not burn.
backstory: Kaska never knew a mortal parent — only that the fire in her veins ran hotter and stranger than any fire genasi she ever met, and that the old ones whispered her bloodline traced back to the City of Brass itself. She wandered the Material Plane as a raid-breaker and monster-hunter until the Emberscar tore open and the whole sky turned the color of her own eyes. She took it as a summons. The Ashen Vow needed a frontliner who could shrug off the flame; Kaska needed passage to the one place that might finally tell her what she is.
